inspired by the pulse of nature, my work moves between music, art, and computational design, bringing together different approaches to creative exploration.

with a background in architecture, my interests lie in exploring the relationships between natural systems, technology, and creative expression. through sound, spatial experimentation, and visual exploration, i explore the connections between rhythm, pattern, and structure across music, architecture, and the natural world.
